headline: Front Lines Stir on Several Sectors
war_summary: Since the last edition, Nevish Line has grown busier: 74 base events are logged for the past day, against 69 previously, with six in the latest two hours. Its ownership tally now stands at five Warden and three Colonial bases, versus six and two before. Marban Hollow also picked up, from 15 to 17 daily events, with two in the latest two hours. Linn Mercy rose from 13 to 16 events and recorded five in six hours, though none in the latest two. Weathered Expanse remains highly active at 51 events, nearly unchanged, and its six Warden, one Colonial and two neutral bases match the prior report; three events occurred in the latest two hours. Kuura Strand eased from 22 to 19 events, with none in the latest two. Stlican Shelf has logged three daily events, including two in the latest two hours. Casualty rates have cooled in several of these contested sectors. War 140 remains undecided, and 34 victory towns are required.
